payload.title: A curator agent proposes guideline changes from newsroom talk
payload.description: A scheduled agent reads threads since its last run and, where editors keep agreeing on something (a running joke, a line not to cross), proposes an edit to the site's guidelines or humour rubric as a review request quoting the threads. A person accepts or rejects; nothing changes guidelines on its own. Scenario: three threads say puns on agency names are tired; the curator proposes a rubric line citing them. Scenario: no recurring point means no proposal.
